timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,412–1,416 KRW per USD

WHY: The won is currently strengthening (declining KRW/USD ratio), with rates moving from ~1,415.7 down to 1,412.80 KRW per USD. While this makes dollar purchases more expensive short-term, news mentions the won may face upward pressure ("상승") as the dollar strengthens globally and retail investors buy on dips, suggesting volatility rather than a clear trend.

TIP: Since you convert a fixed $2,000 monthly, consider dollar-cost averaging—lock in the standard monthly conversion regardless of current levels to avoid timing risk and benefit from averaging over time.
